title: Lexington Revolutionary War Museum Pass (4 Museums)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: ASL tours available via hand-held tablet
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore all four Lexington History Museums—including Buckman Tavern, Hancock-Clarke House, Munroe Tavern, and the Lexington Depot—for an experience no other tour can offer.

Step inside the actual buildings where history happened. Stand in the tavern where Lexington's militia gathered before the Battle of Lexington, visit the home where Patriot leaders John Hancock and Samuel Adams received Paul Revere's warning, and explore the tavern later occupied by British troops in the aftermath of the battle. With admission to all three historic houses included, you'll enjoy an immersive journey through the places where the American Revolution began.

Your pass also includes admission to the Lexington Depot Museum, a beautifully restored 19th-century train station that traces Lexington's story from the Revolutionary era to the present day through engaging exhibits, artifacts, and interactive displays.
